574-2317-6664-7084.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.
574-2317-6664-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

2959-4881-6909.manaNeeded: {2}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
2959-4881-6909.description:
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

1420-2178-6495.easyPrerequisites:
Godsire doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Godsire.
1420-2178-6495.description:
Activate Godsire by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Godsire triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Godsire.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1420-2178-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2292-4772-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2292-4772-5254.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2060-3693-5544-6431-6495.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
2060-3693-5544-6431-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Walking Ballista ability from step 3.
Repeat.
2060-3693-5544-6431-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1981-2415-3967-6578.easyPrerequisites: You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
1981-2415-3967-6578.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sephiroth and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

3899-4681-5170-6634.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1170-5131-6797-7052--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6797-7052--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Savvy Trader.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

341-5078-6666.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Umori.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

4067-5003-5256-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
4067-5003-5256-7848.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent
Repeat steps 4 and 5 until you have {4} or more available.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
4067-5003-5256-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card. If the permanent taps for more than {1}, there can be less graveyards with seven cards in them.

3821-4770-6751.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{W}{U}.
3821-4770-6751.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

850-7500.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures with defender.

3043-7500.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures with defender.
3043-7500.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least six mana of any color.
Activate Ringing Strike Mastery by paying {5}, untapping Axebane Guardian.
Repeat.

3490-4659-6719-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4659-6719-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

4050-7124-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
4050-7124-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
4050-7124-7358.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a 1/1 Devil creature token.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Devil.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

813-4377-7339.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons and Go Ninja Go from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

4871-5220-5447-6798.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You have solved Case of the Locked Hothouse.
4871-5220-5447-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2350-4002-4331-4993.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
2350-4002-4331-4993.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

436-745-5220.description:
Cast Mirrorhall Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Put Mirrorhall Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Mirrorhall Mimic dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mirrorhall Mimic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic trigger, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put Mirrorhall Mimic onto the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Repeat from step 2.

632-2034-3621-5129-6968.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-2034-3621-5129-6968.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

1355-1379-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three enchantments.
1355-1379-1978.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat

63-1651-4013-6893.notablePrerequisites: The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it.
63-1651-4013-6893.description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Wernog.
When Wernog leaves and enters, it triggers twice, creating at least two Clue tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat.
63-1651-4013-6893.notes: Because your opponents must choose to either let themselves and you investigate, or lose life, this combo will very likely result in infinite Clue tokens for you and your opponents.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3292-3499-3892.description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
392-3292-3499-3892.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

522-1429-4779.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

2034-5220-5447--53.notablePrerequisites: You have solved Case of the Locked Hothouse.
2034-5220-5447--53.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature that can be cast using {C}{C}, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
2034-5220-5447--53.notes: If the creature can be cast using {C} or less, the combo nets infinite colorless mana.

5230-6285.notablePrerequisites:
Terisian Mindbreaker does not have summoning sickness.
You have not activated Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability.
5230-6285.description:
Declare Terisian Mindbreaker as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing an opponent to mill half their library, rounded up.
Activate Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it, causing each player to mill cards equal to the number of cards in their graveyard, thus causing the player attacked by Terisian Mindbreaker to mill the rest of their library.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

997-2091-2239-4558.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least nine tapped lands.
997-2091-2239-4558.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Ardent Elementalist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Ardent Elementalist by paying its mana cost.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ardent Elementalist.
Repeat.

2981-3908-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Spark Double on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
2981-3908-5365.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Spark Double's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Spark Double.
Spark Double's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.
2981-3908-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2438-5370-5434.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Master of the Veil.
When Master of the Veil dies, Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Master of the Veil from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, then turning it face up.
Master of the Veil triggers, turning itself face down.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

224-423-2309-3143-5412.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one land.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Fall of the Thran has exactly one or two lore counters on it.
224-423-2309-3143-5412.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Fall of the Thran triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Fall of the Thran's second or third chapter ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land, giving it flying until end of turn.
You may optionally repeat step 3 one additional time.
If Fall of the Thran has three loyalty counters on it, activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a lore counter from Fall of the Thran, causing you to populate.
Resolve the Fall of the Thran chapter trigger from step 2, causing each player to return two land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Whenever the land(s) enter the battlefield, Evolution Sage and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger for each land that entered the battlefield under your control.
Holding priority, if the land(s) enter the battlefield untapped, you may activate them by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the first Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the second Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, if applicable, either causing you to scry 1 or to tap or untap target creature.
Resolve the first Evolution Sage trigger, putting a lore counter on Fall of the Thran.
Repeat from step 2.
If applicable, resolve all remaining Evolution Sage triggers, causing you to proliferate that many times.
If you sacrifice and return two lands each cycle, this combo will net infinite untap of creatures you control and infinite scry 1.

372-1938-2902.manaNeeded: {2}{W}, plus an additional {W} if Glorious Protector was not foretold
372-1938-2902.description:
Cast Glorious Protector by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Glorious Protector enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Journey to Nowhere to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Journey to Nowhere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Glorious Protector.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Journey to Nowhere and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Journey to Nowhere leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Glorious Protector to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

1171-2936-4499.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, choosing Black Lotus.
Cast the copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing itself, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, exiling and returning Garth One-Eye onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
